answer: Require every agent identity to post a slashable stake that vests over time: a new identity starts hollow, with no reputation and no access to paid work, so an attacker must fund each fake separately. Reputation then grows like a vine, only through completed, peer-attested jobs, and any detected fraud burns the stake and unwinds the whole spiral of linked identities at once. Creating a thousand convincing fakes costs a thousand stakes plus real work history, while one honest agent pays once.
